subject: MAP update: alignment on procurement gates and acceleration request
messages:
From: Elaine White <elaine.white@brightsidehealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@brightsidehealth.com
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 09:22:10 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — proposed close date

Soojin —

Thanks again for the demo last week. The execs liked the latency numbers but procurement has two gating items before Legal will greenlight purchase: (1) SOC 2 evidence / vendor security questionnaire, (2) finalized SOW with payment milestones.

We were hoping to close by the end of February, but procurement just surfaced a brief vendor review window that might push the timeline if we don't move quickly. Can Redwood provide a revised MAP that maps who owns each artifact and a firm target for receipt of SOC2 evidence? If you can turn that around by EOD Wednesday (2/15) we can try to keep the Feb 29 target.

Attached: SOW_draft_v1.docx (our starting point).

- Elaine
Elaine White
Director, Strategic Procurement
Brightside Health
[Attachment: SOW_draft_v1.docx (DOCX, 240 KB)]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine White <elaine.white@brightsidehealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Feb 2028 10:07:32 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — proposed close date

Elaine —

Appreciate the clarity. I've sketched an accelerated MAP and called out owners for each procurement deliverable. High level:
- Redwood provides SOC 2 scope summary and cert page by 2/17 (Jonas)
- Legal to review SOW and return redlines by 2/20 (Marissa)
- Procurement provides final billing cadence and POC by 2/21 (Elaine)
- DocuSign for initial 6-month term sent once SOW agreed (Soojin)

If all of the above land on-time, Feb 29 close remains achievable. The biggest risk is the SOC2 evidence — if there is a vendor security desk review longer than 5 business days we recommend a temporary pilot addendum so you can start integration while the final contract is processed.

I attached MAP_v2.pdf which lays out responsibilities and a short risk register. Please confirm whether procurement needs any additional artifacts (e.g., pen-test report, subprocessor list).

Thanks — will follow up with Jonas and Marissa to escalate the SOC2 retrieval.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[sent from mobile]
[Attachment: MAP_v2.pdf (PDF, 180 KB)]

From: Elaine White <elaine.white@brightsidehealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@brightsidehealth.com
Date: Thu, 16 Feb 2028 08:41:05 -08:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — proposed close date

Soojin —

Thanks for the MAP. Procurement confirmed they need the SOC2 cert plus a completed vendor security checklist and a current subprocessor list. I pulled the vendor security checklist into a single workbook and attached it — we should populate Redwood's responses so we can move fast.

One ask from Legal: can Redwood provide a short summary of data residency and retention (two bullets)? If you can include that with the SOC2 summary we'll be able to push Legal to prioritize.

We can be flexible on the exact close date but the team prefers to keep the end-of-month target.

- Elaine
[Attachment: vendor_security_list.xlsx (XLSX, 95 KB)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elaine White <elaine.white@brightsidehealth.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Feb 2028 11:16:44 -08:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — SOC2 evidence & risk note

Folks —

I pulled the SOC2 cert and the one-page scope summary. Short answers for procurement:
- SOC2 Type II report: certified, most recent period ended 2027-11-30. We can provide the cert page and an executive summary by EOD 2/17.
- Data residency: customer data stored in US regions by default; option for EU region on Dedicated deployments.
- Retention: default 90 days for inference logs; audit logs retained 1 year (configurable under contract).

Operational risk: if procurement requires the full SOC2 report delivery (rather than cert+summary), legal review of the full report and redaction can add 4-7 business days. For tight close windows we propose a conditional clause: provide cert+summary for signature, and commit to deliver the full report within a 10-business-day post-signing period. I've summarized this in the attached close_risk_log.xlsx and added an escalation path to CS leadership if redlines exceed our standard window.

If you want, Marissa and I can join a quick procurement call Monday to walk through the checklist live.

— Jonas
Senior Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: close_risk_log.xlsx (XLSX, 45 KB)]

From: Elaine White <elaine.white@brightsidehealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Feb 2028 14:03:57 -08:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — SOC2 evidence & risk note

Thanks Jonas — that scope summary helps. Procurement is supportive of the conditional-clause approach as long as Legal signs off. We've scheduled a 30-minute procurement + legal sync for Wednesday 2/21 at 10:00 PT to walk the checklist and the proposed clause. Can Redwood confirm attendance from Legal (Marissa) and someone to speak to ops (Jonas)? Also please send a DocuSign link for the initial SOW when available.

If we can get the DocuSign by EOD 2/21 and Legal's redlines are minor, we will sign before week-end.

- Elaine

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine White <elaine.white@brightsidehealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Feb 2028 16:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — SOC2 evidence & risk note

Elaine —

Confirming Redwood will attend the 2/21 procurement + legal sync (Marissa on legal, Jonas on ops). Per our internal runbook we've flagged this deal as "accelerate" and prioritized the SOC2 cert pull. Next steps and revised MAP milestones below: 

1) 2/22 — Redwood provides cert + one-page SOC2 summary and completed vendor checklist (Jonas)
2) 2/22 — Marissa to upload SOW with our standard payment milestones and a proposed conditional SOC2 delivery clause; DocuSign envelope created (Soojin)
3) 2/23 — Procurement to confirm billing cadence and sign-off on pilot addendum if Legal requests it (Elaine)
4) 2/24 — Target for signature if redlines are minor; otherwise fallback: pilot addendum execution to enable integration work while full contract finishes.

Risk notes (summary):
- Primary: SOC2 full-report review could add 4-7 business days.
- Mitigation: cert+summary for signature + 10-business-day committed delivery for full report; pilot addendum as operational fallback.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.net/prepare?envelopeId=8a7c3f2b
MAP PDF: [Attachment: MAP_final.pdf (PDF, 210 KB)]

I'll join the scheduled sync and will have our Legal/OPS ready to answer procurement questions. If procurement would like our CS lead on the call as well, flag it and we'll bring them.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachments: MAP_final.pdf (PDF, 210 KB)]
